message: 復習の手段
Test results are out, and the Holy Night Festival is about a month away. The draft plans are mostly set, so now the Student Council just has to pour everything into preparations.
However......

name: Synn
message: 「Starting from now, it'll be over 12 hours」

name: Paqy
message: 「What will?」

name: Synn
message: 「My sleep time, of course」

name: Synn
message: 「Our answer sheets haven't been handed back yet. To make the Holy Night Festival sparkle, I'm going straight to bed as soon as I get home today and give my brain a proper rest」

name: Paqy
message: 「No wonder you didn't put your futon away this morning...... hm?」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey, hold on, Master Synn. What're we gonna do about dinner?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll eat beefsteak in my dreams, so it'll be fine」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me can't pull off a trick like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Is that Riesling-san's car?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Excuse me」

name: Riesling
message: 「Area, 7-0-2, clear」

name: Synn
message: 「......Eh? When did I get home?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yay, a futoo~~n♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「You must not」
I have zero clue what's going on. I was supposed to be on my way home from school, yet somehow I'm slumped over the low table in my own room.
And even though it isn't a Student Council gathering, Lolotte is sitting across from me, and even more unbelievably, Riesling-san of all people is scolding the young lady.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, please stop Jeeves! He's trying to make me take revenge」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nothing is born from revenge. I learned that when I made up with a friend I had a fight with」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hatred is wiped away through forgiveness. However, one cannot forget」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...... Those are really profound words, but they don't fit the current situation at all」
A first-year textbook lies on top of the low table, with sticky notes tucked into the pages that appear to cover this test's material.

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, Lolotte, aren't you mixing up 'review' and 'revenge' on purpose?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gah!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady...」

name: Riesling
message: 「This is a request from the Master, the Mistress, and your friends. Please review the parts you did not understand on the test」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... did you kidnap me just to have me tutor Lolotte?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am deeply obliged」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't drag me away by force--just ask properly!」

name: Riesling
message: 「To save time, it was unavoidable」

name: Riesling
message: 「Considering Student Council activities, the Crusaders, and the crisis of Re-Crea... now is the only time Milady can do self-study」

name: Paqy
message: 「And what's the real reason?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Silence!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「I, Riesling Tooyama, am capable of drilling survival methods in deserts, frigid zones, and tropical rainforests, however...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yay, a cushion~~♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「You must not」

name: Lolotte
message: 「J-Jiiya is scary today... tremble, tremble!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, give it up and let's study」

name: Synn
message: 「For the sake of your family who worries about you, let's review thoroughly and get good results on the next test」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, me getting a good score on a test is ninety-nine percent impossible」

name: Riesling
message: 「In other words, it is point-one percent possible, is it not? I shall report that to the Master, the Mistress, and Lady Amyrina」
No wonder she's Helena-san's friend.
If Riesling-san ever got serious, not only me, even Misa and Ria-senpai wouldn't stand a chance against her in an argument.
While keeping the attention of Lolotte, whose focus tends to drift, I begin reviewing the test. It feels a bit like being a private tutor.
